hooks.command: bash -c 'f=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); [[ "$f" == *.cpp || "$f" == *.h || "$f" == *.c || "$f" == *.hpp ]] && command -v clang-format >/dev/null 2>&1 && clang-format -i "$f" 2>/dev/null || true'
bash -c 'f=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if [[ "$f" == *flake.lock ]]; then echo "Blocked: update flake.lock via: nix flake update" >&2; exit 2; fi'
